mainEntity.name: How do I shorten a URL?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply paste your long URL in the input box on the homepage and click 'Shorten'. You can also shorten multiple URLs at once by entering them line by line.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to create an account?

acceptedAnswer.text: No! You can use Shortenn without registration. However, creating an account allows you to manage your links, view analytics, and access advanced features.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize my short URL?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! When shortening URLs, use the format: URL | custom-alias. Custom aliases must be 3-30 characters and can contain letters, numbers, dashes, and underscores.

mainEntity.name: How do I set an expiry date?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the format: URL | alias | YYYY-MM-DD. Example: https://example.com | summer | 2025-12-31

mainEntity.name: Can I limit the number of clicks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Use the format: URL | alias | expiry | max_clicks. Example: https://example.com | promo | 2025-12-31 | 1000
Yes! Shortenn is completely free with no hidden fees or premium plans. All features are available to everyone.
